rubrics.justification: The response misclassifies the image as a compacting morula/10–16-cell embryo rather than recognizing the provided laboratory designation of an early blastocyst with poor ICM/TE. It also infers fragmentation and cell counts that are not reliably discernible from the image.
It integrates age, DOR, prior live birth, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, and lifestyle factors well, though some links to embryo quality are somewhat speculative and AMH is unavailable.

The reasoning is structured and mostly logical, but it is built on a questionable reinterpretation of the embryo stage and includes some speculative deductions, which weakens the consistency of the final prognosis.

It appropriately notes limitations of applying Gardner grading outside clear blastocyst assessment, but several recommendations are not strongly guideline-based (e.g., low-dose aspirin, ERA without stronger indication, broad endorsement of DHEA/GH/PGT-A in DOR).

Provides clear next-step recommendations for current transfer and future cycles, including protocol reconsideration and counseling, though some suggestions are more speculative than standard practice.
